OncallBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1918501234 - latency spike + error surge on inference-prod-1 - paging oncall
Samir K.: I’m on it, looking at glyph logs now. Seeing a big backlog of requests into the batcher.
Maria T.: customer reports elevated 5xxs since ~09:12 UTC. Which model pool?
Samir K.: inference-prod-1 -> model-pool-gptx-q8. Node group A is the hot path.
Jia Chen: grabbing autoscaler events and GPU metrics. Suspect a failed node + slow retry loop.
Samir K.: repro: continuous queue growth, tail latency > 15s, throughput dropped. stack trace shows many KV cache misses.
Olivia P.: tagging customer-impact: some enterprise customers saw truncation and 504s. Logging a P1 support ticket.
Kofi B.: Can we mitigate with fallback to the smaller variant? We have a compatible quantized variant.
Samir K.: Initiating policy fallback to model-pool-gptx-compact now (manual).
OncallBot: Deploy rollback triggered by Samir K. — started 09:21 UTC — status: in progress
Maria T.: Noted. Samir, please capture the exact command you ran for the postmortem timeline.
Samir K.: ran: `rctl route set --from model-pool-gptx-q8 --to model-pool-gptx-compact --policy=gradual --step=30%`
Jia Chen: autoscaler had 2 failed pods at 09:18 UTC, node A3 returned OOM at 09:16. Docs show kernel OOM kill.
Olivia P.: Customer impact summary draft: ~12 customers affected, median downtime ~4m, worst-case 22m for some requests. Billing unaffected.
Kofi B.: Good mitigation, but we need a permanent fix. Suggest: fix retry loop, harden memory caps, add a judge for KV cache thrash.
Maria T.: Agree. Also need clearer canary for fallback triggers to avoid broad rollouts.
Samir K.: timeline note: root cause likely memory leak in recent KV cache eviction path (PR #4821).
Jia Chen: I pulled heap profiles; saw growth correlated with certain request patterns (long prefix prompts). Will attach heaps and GC logs to the doc.
Olivia P.: Ok moving to post-incident follow-up planning: propose a postmortem meeting 24-48h from now. Who can lead doc drafting?
Samir K.: I can draft the initial RCA writeup (timeline, impact, contributing factors, mitigation).
Maria T.: I’ll do peer review and own the remediation runbook.
Jia Chen: I’ll add logs/metrics and repro steps to the repo.
Kofi B.: I’ll own the long-term reliability task: KV cache refactor + tests. ETA 3 sprints.
Olivia P.: Action items so far: 1) Samir - initial draft (RCA) within 24h. 2) Maria - review + remediation runbook in 48h. 3) Jia - collect artifacts & attach. 4) Kofi - design plan for KV refactor (sprint plan).
Samir K.: Draft outline I’ll use:
```
- Incident summary & impact
- Timeline (with exact commands/events)
- Contributing factors
- Root cause analysis
- Mitigations (short-term + long-term)
- Action items + owners
- Verification plan
```
Maria T.: Please include the exact customer impact table (logos redacted) and token-level latency percentiles.
